summary.text: Check the number in ScamShield. If it is wrongly marked as scam, call the ScamShield Helpline at 1799.

details.heading: A single report is not enough
details.body: A legitimate phone number will not be incorrectly marked as a scam based on a single report.

details.heading: What the check results mean
details.body: The number is blocked only when the result is red and says it looks like a scam. If the result says it is not sure, the number has not been marked as scam or blocked.

steps.name: Check the number
steps.text: Use ScamShield's Check for Scams feature to check whether the phone number is marked as scam.

steps.name: Ask for an unblock
steps.text: If the phone number has been wrongly marked as scam, call the ScamShield Helpline at 1799 to request an unblock.

example_phrasings: What should I do if I accidentally reported a number as scam?
I reported a safe number by mistake. What now?
How can I check if my report blocked a phone number?

sources.page_title: What should I do if I accidentally reported a number as scam?

quotes.text: If you've accidentally reported a number as "scam", you may use the Check for Scams feature to check if the phone number is marked as scam in the ScamShield database.
If you believe a phone number has been wrongly marked as scam, please reach out to the ScamShield Helpline at 1799 to request an unblock.
If this is a legitimate phone number, you don't need to worry. The phone number won't be incorrectly marked as a scam based on a single report.
A phone number is only blocked if the check outcome appears red with the message "Beware, this looks like a scam."
